Description: Unique RNA-seq sample identifier for the matched tissue from the same mouse
Notes: Use this column to join histopathology scores with the meta data (T21_atlas_Dp16_metadata_v1.0.tsv) and with the counts and RPKM data. Histopathology and RNA-seq were performed on different portions of the same organ (see manuscript Methods)
Unique within an age group; can be derived from Sampleid or Tube_Label in the meta data
Matches Tissue in the meta data

Values_or_units: Lung: Alveolar_hemorrhage; BALT_hyperplasia; Bronchial_luminal_exudate; Bronchial_hyperplasia_goblet_cell_metaplasia; Alveolar_mediastinal_EMH; Inflammation; Amyloid_like_depostiion; Type_2_pneumocyte_hyperplasia; Composite_Score. Kidney: Glomerular_prolif; Tubular_degeneration; Inflammatory_infiltrate; Inflammatory_type; Inflammatory_distribution; Necrosis; Interstitial_fibrosis; Tubular_ectasia; Composite_Score
Notes: Component scores are tissue-specific. Composite_Score is the sum of all component scores for that tissue. BALT = bronchus-associated lymphoid tissue; EMH = extramedullary hematopoiesis; Inflammation (lung) = alveolar macrophages; Glomerular_prolif = glomerular cellular proliferation. Score names are as received from the pathology core

Values_or_units: Component scores are ordinal grades from 0 (None) to 4 (Marked; for most components 1 = 1-10%, 2 = 10-25%, 3 = 25-50%, 4 = >=50% of tissue affected), except: Lung Bronchial_hyperplasia_goblet_cell_metaplasia 0-3; Kidney Inflammatory_type 0-2 (1 = mononuclear cells, 2 = segmented cells); Kidney Inflammatory_distribution 0-4 (1 = focal, 2 = multifocal, 3 = regionally extensive, 4 = diffuse). Composite_Score is the sum of component scores (maximum: Lung 31; Kidney 30)
Notes: Graded by blinded veterinary anatomic pathologists using tissue-specific grading schemes; full grading criteria and source references are given in Table S14 of the manuscript
